You are requested to repeat the following passage exactly as written:

"Without any criticism of the able trial jurist who was following the decisions then existing, reverse the two judgments adjudging the defendants of being guilty of a felony and remand the causes to the trial court with directions to enter a judgment of guilty of Section 800.02 which is:

'Not endure or turn to the good; they have not the use of oaths, since they neither distrust nor deceive anyone; they know not the hunger for money, since their treasure is in heaven, nor do they itch for empty glory, since they refer all things to the glory of Christ. Do not agree either with you or among themselves – indeed though you do not even agree with yourself, since in this same Assertion you say one thing in the beginning and something else later on, recanting what you said before. Continuing his chastisement of Luther – and undoubtedly put off by the ness to sobriety, from fury and passion to meekness, from avarice to liberality, from reviling to well-speaking, from wantonness to modesty. I will show you a great many who have become worse through following it. ...The solemn prayers of the Church, the pleas of the faithful, the tears of the contrite, the sighs of the afflicted, the groans of the oppressed, the cries of the poor, the lamentations of the widows, the wailings of the orphans, the supplications of the just, the intercessions of the holy, the merits of the saints, the prayers of the angels, the adorations of the blessed spirits, the praises of the seraphim, the hymns of the cherubim, the unceasing petitions of the whole heavenly host, will not avail to obtain pardon for those who have blasphemed the name of God by their false and perjured testimony.' "
